data: (  $s := $entities("sensor.energy_ev_control_snapshot");  $a := $s.attributes;  $r := $flowContext("ev_mode_recovery_v2");  $p := $entities("sensor.energy_ev_desired_mode");  $v := $entities("select.myenergi_zappi_21539112_charge_mode");  $assert($s.state = "ready" and $p.state = ev_mode and $not($p.attributes.restored = true)    and $abs($toMillis($p.last_changed)-$a.policy_changed_at*1000) < 2 and $a.desired = ev_mode and $a.generation = ev_generation    and $r.token = ev_token and zappi_option = $lookup({"off":"Stopped","eco_plus":"Eco+","eco":"Eco","fast":"Fast"},ev_mode) and $millis()-$a.sampled_at*1000 >= 0 and $millis()-$a.sampled_at*1000 <= 45000    and $millis()-ev_issued_at >= 0 and $millis()-ev_issued_at <= 10000    and (ev_mode = "off" or ($a.actual_available = true and $v.state in ["Stopped","Eco+","Eco","Fast"] and $not($v.attributes.restored = true) and $v.state = $a.actual and $a.actual in ["Stopped","Eco+","Eco","Fast"] and $millis()-$a.policy_changed_at*1000 >= 20000 and $millis()-$a.reported_at*1000 >= 0 and $millis()-$a.reported_at*1000 <= 180000)),    "EV mode request superseded or feedback unavailable; no service sent");  {"option": zappi_option})
